cues.en: Anytime cars and trucks collide,
cues.zh: 每当轿车与卡车相撞，

cues.en: the car is obviously at a disadvantage.
cues.zh: 轿车显然处于劣势。

cues.en: But one of the most devastating kinds of crashes is when a car slides under the trailer of a large truck.
cues.zh: 但最具毁灭性的事故之一，是轿车钻入了大型卡车的挂车底下。

cues.en: Our new research shows that many of the injuries and deaths that occur in these kinds of crashes could be prevented with stronger under right guards.
cues.zh: 我们的最新研究表明，通过使用更坚固的防钻入护栏，这类事故中的许多伤亡本可以避免。

cues.en: We've studied how under right guards are performing in real world crashes and discovered that many are failing catastrophically.
cues.zh: 我们研究了防钻入护栏在现实事故中的表现，发现许多护栏都发生了灾难性的损坏失效。

cues.en: The guard bends or it may break away from the trailer, allowing a vehicle to slide under it.
cues.zh: 护栏会弯曲，也可能从挂车上断裂脱落，让车辆滑到它下面。

cues.en: Our crash test demonstrate how easily some guards fail at relatively low speeds.
cues.zh: 我们的碰撞测试表明，一些护栏在相对较低的速度下就很容易失效。

cues.en: The federal government requires
cues.zh: 联邦政府要求

cues.en: that the backs of somebody truck trailers have underbright guards to prevent vehicles from sliding underneath them in the event of a crash.
cues.zh: 某些卡车挂车的尾部必须安装底部防护栏，以防发生碰撞时车辆滑入车底。

cues.en: Our crash tests show,
cues.zh: 我们的碰撞测试显示，

cues.en: that the standard is not as strong as it could be and as strong as it should be to prevent this kind of underwrite.
cues.zh: 该标准不够强，本可以更强，也应该更强，才能防止这类钻底事故。

cues.en: Cars front end structures are designed to crush in a way to minimize injuries to occupants in serious frontal crashes.
cues.zh: 汽车的前端结构经过专门设计，能在发生严重正面碰撞时通过溃缩来最大程度减轻乘员的伤亡。

cues.en: But when you crash into the back of a large truck,
cues.zh: 但如果是追尾一辆大卡车，

cues.en: that protection only works if the truck's under ride guard stays in place.
cues.zh: 只有在卡车的防钻撞护栏保持完好的情况下，这种保护才能发挥作用。

cues.en: The Chevrolet Malibu is a top safety pick.
cues.zh: Chevrolet Malibu 曾获评顶级安全车（Top Safety Pick）。

cues.en: And this is a Malibu after a 40 mile per hour crash with another car. The front end structure has absorbed the crash energy from that, and you can see there's lots of survival space in the occupant compartment.
cues.zh: 这是 Malibu 以 40 英里时速撞向另一辆车后的样子，前端结构吸收了碰撞能量，可以看到乘员舱依然留有充裕的生存空间。

cues.en: This is a Malibu after it struck the rear end of a trailer with a weak underwrite guard at only 35 miles an hour.
cues.zh: 这是一辆Malibu，以仅35英里的时速撞上了一辆拖车的尾部，而该拖车的防钻入护栏很薄弱。

cues.en: This front structure never got a chance to do its work.
cues.zh: 这个前部结构根本没机会发挥作用。

cues.en: Instead, the trailer just pushed back, peeled the hood back, put it into the laps of the dummies,
cues.zh: 相反，拖车只是向后推，把引擎盖掀开，压到了假人的腿上，

cues.en: and real people could have been decapitated in a crash like this.
cues.zh: 在这样的事故中，真人可能会被斩首。

cues.en: The Wabash trailer had the strongest underride guard in this series.
cues.zh: 这辆Wabash拖车拥有本系列中最坚固的防钻入护栏。

cues.en: Its guard meets a tougher Canadian standard. This Wabash trailer prevented underride when the Malibu struck it in the center where the guard is stronger.
cues.zh: 它的护栏符合更严格的加拿大标准。当Malibu撞上护栏更坚固的中央位置时，这辆Wabash拖车防止了钻入。

cues.en: But it was a very different story when the Malibu crashed into only the outer end of the guard.
cues.zh: 但当 Malibu 仅仅撞上护栏的外侧末端时，情况就截然不同了。

cues.en: The guard isn't strong enough there, and it allowed the Malibu to slide under the trailer,
cues.zh: 护栏在那里的强度不够，导致 Malibu 直接钻到了挂车底下，

cues.en: and the trailer ends up back in the occupant compartment.
cues.zh: 挂车最终侵入了乘员舱。

cues.en: Cars are much more crash worthy than they used to be, but the federal standard for underbright guards hasn't kept pace.
cues.zh: 现在的汽车耐撞性比以往强得多，但联邦对防钻撞护栏的标准却没能跟上步伐。

cues.en: Many crashes with big rigs would be much less severe with a stronger federal rule.
cues.zh: 如果有更严格的联邦法规，许多与大型货车相撞的事故严重程度都会大大降低。
